findings.note: Black fills, open-line hands and tiny chain links.
Hour marks are solid black dots; draw them as hollow circles (outline only, empty inside).
Clock hands are single lines; draw them as two closed slim bar shapes that can be coloured.
Chains are tiny rings; draw each chain as one plain straight bar or rod with no links.
